Read the recorded source artifacts, one row per expected artifact

Source: R/lnk_artifact.R
lnk_artifact_read.Rd

Reports every primitive this host should have a record for, with status = "missing" where it has none — a missing record is reported, not silently left out. A record whose table no longer exists (dropped since it was loaded, e.g. by state_clean.sh) reads "table_absent": the record outlives the table, and names a load the database no longer holds. The stream network expands to one expected artifact per watershed group loaded in this database.

Usage

lnk_artifact_read(conn, host = .lnk_host())

Arguments

conn

A DBI::DBIConnection.

host

Host label; see lnk_artifact_record().

Value

A data frame: the recorded columns plus status ("recorded" / "missing" / "table_absent").

See also

Other provenance: lnk_artifact_probe(), lnk_artifact_record()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
conn <- lnk_db_conn(dbname = "fwapg", host = "localhost", port = 5432L,
                    user = "postgres", password = "postgres")
a <- lnk_artifact_read(conn)
table(a$table_name, a$status)
} # }
